findings.issue: Common noun H4908 (definite article + singular) is left as the untranslated transliteration mishkán.
hay que is readily read as obligation; the tokens license existence plus a relative.
Unmarked de joins two absolute nouns; neither token is construct.

notes: The עַל־פִּי יְהוָה pair and the three qal imperfects are repeated without added participants.
